title: onboarding-questions
description: Step 1 of `team onboard`: the onboarding role reads the owner's brief and returns ONE batch of clarifying questions and the list of accounts/access the team will need, each with its reason. The dispatcher renders it as products/<slug>/onboarding/questions.md for the owner to fill in.

summary.description: 2–3 sentences: how the team understood the product, in the language of the brief

why.description: what decision in VISION / the first milestone depends on the answer

default.description: the answer applied when the owner leaves the field empty; the most conservative, cheapest, reversible one

accounts.description: everything the team does not have and needs: hosting, domain, database, payments, analytics, asset generation, stores. Only what the brief or the milestones actually require.

why.description: which task or milestone stops without it

needed_by.description: milestone id (M0, M1, …) or a date

who_creates.description: team = the roles can set it up themselves inside existing permissions

hand_over.description: what to hand over and where: the NAME of the secret in .env on the server, a host name in product.yaml — never a value

assumptions.description: what the team took for granted without asking; the owner may correct any of them in the answers
